description: This Java class defines a JPA entity named 'Tag', representing user-defined tags for books in the book tracking application. It includes properties such as 'id' and 'name', and maintains a many-to-many relationship with 'Book' entities. It also overrides 'equals' and 'hashCode' methods based on 'name'.

classes.description: JPA entity class representing a user-defined tag for books, with a unique 'name' and a many-to-many relationship with 'Book' entities. Utilizes Lombok annotations for boilerplate code generation and custom annotations for exclusion from reporting.
